items.stem: A stone is projected vertically upwards with speed 15 m s⁻¹ from a point 20 m above the ground. Find the time taken to reach the ground.
items.markingKey: M1 −20 = ut − 5t²; M1 solves the quadratic; A1 time [3]

items.stem: A particle is projected vertically upwards with speed 5 m s⁻¹ from a point A, which is 5 m above the ground. (a) Find the greatest height above the ground reached. (b) Find the time taken to reach the ground. (c) Find the speed with which it reaches the ground.
items.markingKey: (a) M1 v² = u² − 2gs; A1 height [2] (b) M1 quadratic in t; A1 time [2] (c) M1 v² = u² + 2gs; A1 speed [2]

items.stem: A velocity-time graph for a train is a straight line from (0, 0) to (12, 25). Find the distance travelled in this time.
items.markingKey: Area of the triangle = (1/2) × base × height.

items.stem: A particle moves with velocity 4 m s⁻¹ for 3 s and then with velocity −4 m s⁻¹ for 4 s. Sofia says its displacement and distance travelled are both 28 m. Explain the error.
items.answer: Distance travelled = 12 + 16 = 28 m, but displacement = 12 − 16 = −4 m because the second motion is in the opposite direction.
items.markingKey: B1 distance correct; B1 displacement subtracts [2]

items.stem: A train accelerates uniformly from rest to 30 m s⁻¹ in 12 s. Amara says the distance travelled is 30 × 12 = 360 m. Explain the error and find the correct distance.
items.answer: The speed is not 30 m s⁻¹ throughout; distance is the area under the graph, a triangle: (1/2) × 12 × 30 = 180 m.
items.markingKey: B1 area of the triangle, not rectangle; B1 correct distance [2]

items.stem: A train starts from rest and accelerates uniformly to 25 m s⁻¹ in 5 s and then decelerates uniformly to rest in 4 s. Find the total distance travelled.
items.markingKey: M1 area under the velocity-time graph; A1 distance [2]

items.stem: A lorry starts from rest and accelerates uniformly to 12 m s⁻¹ in 10 s, travels at this speed for 40 s and then decelerates uniformly to rest in 4 s. Find the acceleration in the first stage and the total distance travelled.
items.markingKey: B1 acceleration; M1 area; A1 distance [3]

items.stem: A train starts from rest and accelerates uniformly to 8 m s⁻¹ in 20 s. It travels at this speed for 10 s and then decelerates uniformly to rest in 6 s. (a) Find the total distance travelled. (b) Find the average speed for the whole journey.
items.markingKey: (a) M1 area; A1 distance [2] (b) M1 distance ÷ time; A1 value [2]

items.stem: A car has initial speed 12 m s⁻¹ and constant acceleration −1 m s⁻². Find the distance travelled in 10 s.
items.markingKey: s = ut + (1/2)at².

items.stem: Grace is told that a car moving at 54 km h⁻¹ brakes uniformly to rest in 10 s, and uses u = 54 in v = u + at. Explain the error and find the deceleration.
items.answer: Speeds must be in m s⁻¹: 54 km h⁻¹ = 15 m s⁻¹, so the deceleration is 1.5 m s⁻².
items.markingKey: B1 converts units; B1 correct deceleration [2]

items.stem: Lina is told that a car moving at 90 km h⁻¹ brakes uniformly to rest in 3 s, and uses u = 90 in v = u + at. Explain the error and find the deceleration.
items.answer: Speeds must be in m s⁻¹: 90 km h⁻¹ = 25 m s⁻¹, so the deceleration is 8.33 m s⁻².
items.markingKey: B1 converts units; B1 correct deceleration [2]

items.stem: A van moving in a straight line with constant acceleration passes a point A with speed 8 m s⁻¹ and a point B, 15 m further on, with speed 2 m s⁻¹. Find the acceleration and the time taken from A to B.
items.markingKey: M1 v² = u² + 2as; A1 acceleration; A1 time [3]

items.stem: A tram passes a point A with speed 8 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 1.5 m s⁻² for 10 s. It then travels at constant speed for 30 s before decelerating uniformly to rest in 5 s. (a) Find the maximum speed. (b) Find the total distance from A to the point where it comes to rest.
items.markingKey: (a) M1 v = u + at; A1 speed [2] (b) M1 adds the three stages; A1 total [2]

items.stem: A train passes a point A with speed 15 m s⁻¹ and accelerates uniformly at 2 m s⁻² for 3 s. It then travels at constant speed for 10 s before decelerating uniformly to rest in 8 s. (a) Find the maximum speed. (b) Find the distance travelled while accelerating. (c) Find the deceleration in the final stage.
items.markingKey: (a) M1 v = u + at; A1 speed [2] (b) M1 s = ut + (1/2)at²; A1 distance [2] (c) B1 value [1]

items.stem: A pebble is projected vertically upwards with speed 14 m s⁻¹. Find the greatest height above the point of projection.
items.markingKey: v² = u² − 2gs with v = 0.

items.stem: A ball is thrown upwards at 25 m s⁻¹. Noah takes a = +10 m s⁻² with upwards positive and finds the displacement after 2 s to be 70 m. Explain the error and find the correct displacement.
items.answer: With upwards positive, a = −10 m s⁻²: s = 25(2) − 5(4) = 30 m.
items.markingKey: B1 sign of g; B1 correct displacement [2]

items.stem: Nadia says that a ball thrown upwards at 8 m s⁻¹ has zero acceleration at its highest point because it is momentarily at rest. Explain why this is wrong.
items.answer: The velocity is zero at the top, but gravity still acts, so the acceleration is 10 m s⁻² downwards throughout.
items.markingKey: B1 velocity zero; B1 acceleration still g downwards [2]
